title: trajectory — position of an entity = function of time (4D)
description: A trajectory is a LIST of segments sorted by ascending 'de', with no gaps or overlaps (invariant 01 §5.3, contract §3.7). Two segment forms: stay {lieu, de, a} and movement {type:'deplacement', de, a, chemin[...], motif}. 'a':null = current/undefined segment. This schema validates an ISOLATED trajectory; it is also reused by actor.schema.json ($defs.trajectoire). Dynamic invariants (continuity, no teleportation, monotonicity vs current T) are verified by worldlib.valider_trajectoire — not expressible in pure JSON Schema.

segment.description: Trajectory segment: stay OR movement. The distinction is made on the 'type' field (== 'deplacement' for movement, absent/other for stay).

sejour.description: Stay: the entity remains at location 'lieu' from instant 'de' to instant 'a' (T in UT).

lieu.description: id of the stay location (must exist in geo.json).

deplacement.description: Movement: the entity travels along 'chemin' (sequence of location ids, consecutive real edges) from 'de' to 'a'. The duration (a-de) must be ≥ sum of times_ut along the path (no teleportation).

a.description: Arrival time (UT). null allowed for undefined ongoing movement.

chemin.description: Ordered sequence of location ids following consecutive existing edges.

motif.description: Narrative reason for movement (ex. "migration — famine (evt:incendie-champs)"). Optional.
